The `mode` docblock stops naming charts and pivot tables as its users. One pin per block over its refused members, each with a read member as the control. objectui#9002's PR objectui#10681 has merged, so nothing is serial.

Serial constraints cleared: open-PR file lists read 2026-09-25T19:13Z. PR objectui#10643 (this seat, objectui#10583, in contract review) edits `packages/types/src/data-display.ts` at about `:702-:801` and `zod/data-display.zod.ts` at about `:280-:346`; `DrillDownConfig` is at `:2262` and `DrillDownConfigSchema` at `:881`, so the hunks are disjoint.
